what_was_attempted: Calculate a comparison involving the Moon's minimum perigee distance and Eliud Kipchoge's record time.
approach_taken: The agent first issued a web search for the Wikipedia Moon minimum-perigee value, then recognized that the snippet was insufficient and described fetching the Lunar distance and Kipchoge pages directly. No direct page fetch or calculation was actually executed.
where_it_went_wrong: The search returned only a partial Lunar distance snippet and did not provide the exact values needed. The agent then failed to emit the proposed follow-up retrieval action and ended by stating that it could not calculate the result.
